- Commit: 250M tokens/month baseline (12-month term).
- Step-up tiers: 250–499M @ $9.50/1M; 500–999M @ $8.00/1M; 1B+ negotiate via exec review.
- Q4 spike handling: burst capacity available at negotiated step-up pricing; we’ll provide a safety cap and automatic notification.
- Estimated blended rate at expected profile (250M baseline + Q4 months to 800M): ~ $8.25/1M.

Option B — Flex + blended credits (less commit, higher variability):
- No baseline commit, pay-as-you-go with volume discounts: 0–249M @ $12.00/1M; 250–499M @ $10.00/1M; 500–999M @ $8.75/1M.
- Blended estimate for your expected profile: ~ $9.50/1M.

- Blended calculations in the attached sheet show exact math for the three scenarios; I highlighted the rows where the $8–$10 target is met.
- Adding two new storefront routes is straightforward; SE (Dev) confirmed there are no model architecture blockers. There will be small additional per-route overhead for logging/observability (covered in sheet).
- For the higher-capacity reranker model we may recommend a separate route with a heavier token profile — we can roll that into the step-up tiers or price it as a premium model route.

Next practical step: I’ll update the sheet to show a proposed amendment (commit language + step-up schedule + blended examples) and share with procurement. If procurement confirms the commit threshold, I can route to legal for an amendment.

Would you prefer Option A (commit) or Option B (flex) as the basis for procurement? Happy to jump on a 20-min call tomorrow to walk through the numbers.
